usedFor: Shopify takes the sale and Notion keeps the team's databases. “Order Paid” in Shopify can add an entry through “Create_Data_Source_Item”, building a running order log the team can sort and comment on.

bestTemplate.name: “Order Paid” in Shopify, then “Create_Data_Source_Item” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Paid is the order that counts, and the action writes a new item into a Notion data source, which is a better log than “New Customer” or “New Product”.

watchOut: “Order Line Items Are Edited” can run the same action, so an edited order would add a second item. Keep “Order Paid” as the one trigger for the log.
